actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent transcriptional program (coagulation/glycolysis/apical surface up, heme metabolism down) with no technical confounder association, supporting a defensible discovery-stage identity. Cross-modal boundaries are weak but not incompatible, and no available request remains, so it is retained for downstream validation with acknowledged structural uncertainty.

C0002 shows strong coherent immune/interferon RNA activation plus highly significant BAP1 enrichment, with stable fused structure (ARI 1.0) and positive RNA/WXS probe support. The only confounder flag is a CT-phase UNKNOWN missingness category rather than a substantive acquisition driver, so the candidate remains defensible for downstream validation.

C0003 has coherent multimodal support: significant TGF-beta/WNT/Notch RNA shifts, distinctive CNV alterations, and a consistent PBRM1-high/BAP1-absent pattern, with the strongest cross-modal membership support and no technical confounder association. It is retained as a defensible discovery-stage candidate.

C0004 has a coherent genomic identity (near-absent VHL/PBRM1 mutations) but its cross-modal structure is almost entirely WXS-driven and it shows significant CT acquisition-parameter associations. No available request can resolve these concerns in this round, so it is retained only as a discovery-stage candidate with explicit caveats.

C0005 shows a coherent metabolic/adipogenic RNA program with significant DST mutation enrichment and chr8p loss enrichment, and no technical confounder association. Cross-modal boundaries are weak, but the identity signal is defensible enough to retain for downstream validation.

C0006 has a coherent genomic identity (universal VHL mutation with PBRM1/BAP1 absence) and stable fused structure, though membership support is largely WXS-driven. With no technical confounder association and no available request, it is retained as a discovery-stage candidate.

C0007 has no significant biological support in any modality, and its cross-modal structure is not reliably estimable at n=4. The candidate is insufficiently defensible for retention, and no available evidence request could reasonably reverse this conclusion.
